_doc: RI-015 fixture. Anthropic /v1/messages supports top_k as a sampling parameter. XLI's AnthropicInboundRequest declares temperature + top_p but NOT top_k — serde silently drops it. The downstream /responses sampling envelope expects top_k where the model supports it (Claude, some Vertex variants). This fixture parses a request carrying top_k=40 and asserts the parsed AnthropicInboundRequest does NOT carry the field (current contract), documenting the gap.

_known_gap.description: top_k sampling parameter is silently dropped on the inbound leg. AnthropicInboundRequest needs a `top_k: Option<u32>` field + plumbing to the /responses sampling envelope.
